name: adam
role: Adam optimizer kernel — gradient accumulation, moment estimation, and parameter update. Dispatched via SMCA kernel pipeline.
description: Adam is the native optimizer µ. It receives gradient tensors from the backward_pass µ, maintains first/second moment buffers, and writes updated parameters back to the DDS shard. Runs on the kxc pipeline (kernel_class: adam_optimizer).
invariants: moment buffers are co-located with parameter shards in DDS
step count must be monotonically increasing
bias correction is always applied (no warmup skip)
kernel dispatch goes through SMCA contract verification before execution
